description: This source file defines the `FunctionSchema` class, a utility for representing and managing standardized function schemas for AI tool definitions. It provides mechanisms for initializing schema objects with specific properties, converting them to dictionary form, and accessing individual attributes such as name, description, properties, and required parameters.
